column4: swarm-thompson-construction (uncompiled), tex l.447-451: ThompsonConstruction/{Delta,Host,Endpoints}. Supersedes the Open clause of swarm-boone-higman. Proved unconditionally: solvable WP => G embeds in the f.g. simple lamplighter host G_Delta of an infinite Delta with solvable WP (level-shift Delta without LEF, then [Delta,Delta] into EL_3(R_Delta)); a f.g. simple group has solvable WP iff it is recursively presented (Kuznetsov with S = top). Conditional on the single isolated gap HostRecursivePresentationStatement (G_Delta is recursively presented for infinite Delta with solvable WP; true by lem:host, equivalent to solvable WP of G_Delta, discharged by Lamplighter.PrintedLamplighterHostSolvableWordProblem): solvable WP => (a), and for f.g. G the iff WP <=> (a) <=> (b) <=> (c). Thompson's 1980 construction itself is not formalized.
